openings.claim: Construction candidate: separate positioning from restraint by seating each rod against two fixed reference faces and an insertion stop before closing a captive clamp. Replace full-width tight-fit dependency with reference seating. Plywood carries contacts, bolts adjust/provide stops, cord or elastic keepers retain moving pieces/fasteners. Clamp travel accommodates 18/19/20 mm rods without relocating references.
openings.discriminator: Nearest rival: tighter enclosure improves accuracy through stiffness alone. Seating predicts consistently seated clearance can return closer than tight fit despite comparable loaded displacement; rival predicts return and loaded displacement improve together as clearance decreases. Both patterns remain uncertain; two supplied trials establish neither cause.
openings.probe: Within 100-minute fabrication allowance, attempt one reference-seat assembly with two clearance settings. Check complete joint inside 90 mm cube, hand operation only, no rod drilling/adhesive/permanent marks, and every component retained throughout removal. Establish marked pointer position once. Per setting, log five exchanges of each original rod plus two 18 mm replacement exchanges: return position and seconds. Perform four ten-second 10 N trials after exchanges 1/5/10/12. Compare return error and additional loaded displacement separately; keep final two replacement observations distinct. Respect two configurations maximum, twelve exchanges/four loads each, and twenty minutes total testing.
openings.uncertainty: Supplied plywood/eight bolts must provide sufficiently rigid references, captive adjustment and stops within envelope; detailed fastening geometry unresolved. Defeat if references move, clearance prevents reliable seating, any component falls free, or fabrication/testing exceeds capacity. Reject operational adequacy if any required return/load exceeds 2 mm target circle or exchange takes forty seconds or more; favorable comparison alone is insufficient. Resource sufficiency and coupled effects limit interpretation; no deployment, reliability or load-capacity result supplied.

lineage.reason: Preserves seating relation, stiffness rival, comparative predictions, probe, uncertain fit, feasibility and defeat limits.

decision: Retain one uncertain construction/discrimination candidate; feasibility and operational adequacy await bounded testing.
